name: io.github.tunnels-io/tunnels-mcp
title: tunnels.io
description: Read a tunnels.io account and put local ports online. Lists only the tools the token was granted.

environmentVariables.name: TUNNELS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A tunnels.io token, starting tnl_. Create one at tunnels.io/account/tokens under "Connect an AI assistant".

environmentVariables.name: TUNNELS_CLI
environmentVariables.description: Path to the tunnels CLI. start_tunnel and stop_tunnel need it.
